decision_records.question: Which issuer-owned machine payload, state namespace, version and provenance become the governed Certifier-to-Registry producer contract?
decision_records.source_evidence: Stage 3A/3B canonical-source pins and owner inquiry

evidence_required.requirement: Issuer-adopted serialization/profile and version identifier
Owner-specified canonical current-state and historical retrieval reference
Attributable origin, effective schema, source version and exact issuer status/outcome fields
Documented unavailable/unknown and bad-version behavior

candidate_refusals.case: missing exact SC-CERT source identifier
toolkit CERTIFIED inferred as canonical Issued · Active
schema_version used as package_version
stale or unavailable issuer source treated as current

decision_records.question: What receiving method and which Registry principal may consider a source-record registration request?
decision_records.source_evidence: Stage 3A/3B canonical-source pins and owner inquiry

evidence_required.requirement: Registry-approved intake operation/request format versus separate SREG output format
Receiving owner, delegated role, effective policy and negative response types
Independent registrability, validation, issuance and publication decision sequence
Explicit no-entry-created result until Registry-owned issuance

candidate_refusals.case: SREG output profile mistaken for intake endpoint
Certifier toolkit sreg_stub treated as issued Registry object
structural conformance treated as registrability or publication
attempt to issue SREG under source-only permission

decision_records.question: Which machine statuses/versions and governed transitions control Registry records while keeping Certifier state independent?
decision_records.source_evidence: Stage 3A/3B canonical-source pins and owner inquiry

evidence_required.requirement: Separate issuer source version/status and Registry entry version/status/lifecycle namespaces
Registry-owned reconciliation of Base Schema values versus partial published controlled-values JSON
Governed machine lifecycle value-set/transition vocabulary and effective version
Explicit source state-at-use, separately checked current-state, unknown/stale outcomes

candidate_refusals.case: status active in Registry inferred from Certifier Issued · Active
Published lifecycle rejected solely because different lifecycle README omits the term
prose Active silently mapped to machine published
historical source v1.1 overwritten with latest unverified version
lifecycle enum membership treated as transition approval

decision_records.question: Is a distinct Suite relationship needed alongside native registers, and what approved semantics and owners apply?
decision_records.source_evidence: Stage 3A/3B canonical-source pins and owner inquiry

evidence_required.requirement: Registry-owned native registers direction SREG→source package
Separate optional Suite predicate semantics, direction, evidence strength and inverse policy
Unsupported mapping rejection; no silent references synonym substitution
Multi-relation and provenance semantics when individually supported

candidate_refusals.case: registers replaced silently by references
derived-from or supports inferred without evidence
inverse relationship assumed from identifier equality
relationship used as permission to alter Certifier decision

decision_records.question: Who can authorize any receiving action and what verified audit/readback proof is required?
decision_records.source_evidence: Stage 3A/3B canonical-source pins and owner inquiry

evidence_required.requirement: Named authenticated nonproduction caller and Registry receiving decision right
Rule-version and documented delegation/approval context
Replay-safe attempt identity, refusal and durable audit requirements
Independent actual Registry result readback/negative owner authorization evidence

candidate_refusals.case: network access treated as Registry registration authority
acknowledgement receipt treated as approval
duplicate request creates second Registry decision
claimed audit digest or signature treated as verified trust
partial write treated as complete

decision_records.question: Which reproducible read-only evidence establishes historical/current source and Registry representation parity?
decision_records.source_evidence: Stage 3A/3B canonical-source pins and owner inquiry

evidence_required.requirement: Immutable historical source and SREG blob/version and capture context
At-use source state distinguished from current issuer observation
Registry human-readable representation compared to SREG record.json with field-level exceptions
Non-destructive correction/supersession event and provenance policy

candidate_refusals.case: human page and JSON have conflicting status or source version
missing issuer readback silently classified as current
source correction overwrites prior SREG history
downstream acknowledgement treated as issuer-current-state proof

labeled_exception.human: Preserved as historical source assessment data
proposed_questions: Is 'source' a permitted explanatory qualifier in this Registry field?
Should documented human rendering permit additions to exact machine status text?
Does any consuming process rely on machine exact value or public wording?
labeled_exception.not_proven: No approved semantic equivalence or material conflict determination
labeled_exception.recommended_action: Registry owner review and explicit exception/normalization rule; no canonical edit

ordered_owner_hand_off.question: Adopt issuer-provided canonical source payload and provenance specification
ordered_owner_hand_off.required: Written scoped schema/version, source version/currentness source, status/outcome meanings, issuer signed attribution; no reliance on toolkit stub

ordered_owner_hand_off.question: Decide whether any receiving contract exists or should be defined
ordered_owner_hand_off.required: Registry-owned intake operation, role, refusal/unknown response, source-specific rules, with explicit separation from SREG output schema

ordered_owner_hand_off.question: Reconcile source versus Registry version, lifecycle and publication value sets
ordered_owner_hand_off.required: Approved namespace mapping, machine controlled values, effective transition rules and historical Published treatment

ordered_owner_hand_off.question: Govern native registers and optional Suite predicate relationship separately
ordered_owner_hand_off.required: Predicate direction, authority, evidence and unsupported mappings

ordered_owner_hand_off.question: Approve explicit receiving policy identity and audit prerequisites
ordered_owner_hand_off.required: Named principal, effective governance policy, replay/audit/readback requirements; no implicit authenticated access

ordered_owner_hand_off.question: Decide historical/current parity and one observed wording exception
ordered_owner_hand_off.required: Field-level exception disposition; 93 unscoped and 147 no direct field matches; historical correction and authorized issuer-currentness evidence

approval_preconditions: Actual governing owner identity and authority verified independently of document contents
Explicit effective contract ID and source version and read-only scope
Owner approval is institution-specific and not inferred from acknowledgements
No write-capable testing or authentication until separate founder and receiving institution authorization
Any approved exception preserves prior human/machine historical record and version chronology
